Mode() returns the package-level variable modeName (a string), i.e. the current mode name: one of DebugMode ("debug"), ReleaseMode ("release") or TestMode ("test"). It's set by SetMode (and by init() from the GIN_MODE env var); the initial default is DebugMode. There's also IsDebugging(), which reports ginMode == debugCode.

#1 FIXED. Root cause: in errors.go, `Error()` had a value receiver but `Unwrap()` had a pointer receiver, so a non-pointer gin.Error value satisfied `error` but was not unwrappable — errors.Is/errors.As could not see through it. Change: `func (msg *Error) Unwrap() error` → `func (msg Error) Unwrap() error` (one line, errors.go:94). Verified: errors.Is/errors.As/errors.Unwrap now work for both value and pointer gin.Error; full `go test ./...` passes and no previously-passing test fails.

#4 FIXED. Root cause in response_writer.go: WriteHeader warned that headers were already written ("Wanted to override status code %d with %d") but then still assigned w.status = code, so Status() reported a code that was never sent on the wire. Fix: added the missing early `return` in the already-written branch, so the first written status is preserved. Verified: c.String(200,"hi") then c.Status(500) now reports Status()==200 (recorder 200), c.Status(404) alone still 404; gofmt clean, go build ok, full `go test ./...` unchanged (all pass, no previously-passing test broken).
